data.name: Zuriel
data.gender_notes: Zuriel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew words ‘Zur’ meaning help and ‘El’ meaning God. In the Bible, Zuriel is mentioned as an assistant to King Solomon and a warrior who fought in his army. The name Zuriel carries the meaning “God of help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zuriel usually hope their child will grow to embody god of help and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine aid and assistance.
data.etymology: Zuriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zuriel total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: צוּרְיֵאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: צוּרְיֵאל (Zuriel) - בֶּן-אֵל (son of God), בֶּן-קֶסֶם (son of excellence), כּוֹסֶמֶת (cup of excellence), רֹאשׁ-אִל (head of God) - שֵם עברי-כְּנַעֲנִי (Hebrew-Cananaite name) - השם יצא בפטרוס (name appears in Peter's writings) - נושא פרשנות של חסידות ופעולה (associated with humility and action) - בחג הסוכות, כורת-א-צמד (cut of the sukkah) - כל השלום - רשע נקי (all peace - pure wickedness)

in_greek.name: Ζουριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζουριήλ (Zuriel) - υιός θεού (son of God), αριστέας (excellent), κύριος (lord), κράτος (power) - ονομασία παλαιά (ancient name) - προέρχεται από τα εβραϊκά (originates from Hebrew) - αφορά την εξουσία του Θεού (concerns God's power) - εν τούτοις, αφορά και την προσωπικότητα (in this sense, it concerns personality) - η λέξη συνδέεται με το θρήσκευμα (word associated with religion) - συνδέεται με την εξουσία του Θεού

in_latin.name: Zuriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Zuriel - filius Dei (son of God), excellentia (excellence), dominus (lord), potestas (power) - nomen antiquum (ancient name) - originabit a Hebraico (originates from Hebrew) - concernit Dei potestatem (concerns God's power) - in hac sensu, concernit personalitatem (in this sense, it concerns personality) - verbum conexum est religioni (word associated with religion) - conexum est potestati Dei

in_english.name: Zuriel
in_english.meaning: son of God, excellence, lord, power, gift of God
in_english.long_meaning: Zuriel - a Hebrew name meaning 'gift of God', 'excellence', 'lord', or 'power' - associated with biblical references, such as Peter's writings - indicates humility and action - in the Jewish tradition, the name is related to the Sukkot festival - in Christianity, it symbolizes God's power and authority - a name that conveys strength and character - a popular choice for Christian parents - often associated with qualities such as kindness, compassion, and wisdom

data.cultural_impact: The name Zuriel, rooted in Hebrew history, carries the essence of ancient wisdom and strength. It honors the richness of Jewish heritage and the warrior spirit of those who defended their faith.
data.spiritual_significance: With the very foundation of the name signifying God’s help, Zuriel is a reminder of the strengthening presence of God within us during our challenges. It calls us to trust in His support and aid, and to embody the spirit of a brave and loyal servant who fights for His kingdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zuriel: Radiance of God. A name given to those who bring light and revelation to others. This name signifies a strong connection to the divine and a commitment to illuminating the path for others.

biblical_reference.note: Zuriel is mentioned in 1 Peter 5:5 as an example of humility and submission

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Biblical name of an angel The name Zuriel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: In the Hebrew Bible, Zuriel is the name of an angel who appears in the Book of Tobit.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Zuriel continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Grace Zuriel in Rome, Italy credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Zuriel, which means "God of help". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
